wwo.name: Sydney
wwo.method: Sydney Cove core and lower Darling Harbour east bank use faint Health Map 1900 outlines on the State Library 1807–1900 overlay. Only interpreted 1900 water and dry ground are classified. The 1887 atlas supplies the surrounding Pyrmont, rail and Surry Hills corridors. Frontage lots, dimensions and paving are inferred outside directly traced building footprints.

registration.limits: Seven approximate feature matches. Independent registration of the peripheral areas is absent. Some waterfront features changed inside the date window. Stable street controls are approximate.
